title: Correct Porsche acceleration
description: Essential: Student calculates the Porsche's average acceleration as approximately 6.61 m/s² using proper unit conversion and formula.

title: Correct ordinary car time
description: Essential: Student calculates the ordinary car's acceleration time as approximately 9.26 s using the same velocity conversion.

title: Proper unit conversion
description: Important: Student converts 100 km/h to m/s (27.78 m/s) before applying acceleration formulas.

title: Correct acceleration formula
description: Important: Student uses a = Δv/Δt for constant acceleration or recognizes average acceleration definition.

title: Consistent velocity value
description: Important: Student uses the same converted velocity value (27.78 m/s) for both parts of the problem.

title: Unit analysis
description: Optional: Student includes units in calculations and verifies final units (m/s² and s).

title: Missing unit conversion
description: Pitfall: Student uses 100 km/h directly without converting to m/s, leading to incorrect numerical answers.

title: Formula misapplication
description: Pitfall: Student uses kinematic equations assuming constant acceleration incorrectly (e.g., using x = ½at² when not needed).
